_note: v2.8 plan 53 (no-model lane): a faction move fires on a seeded gate, the band word changes on the player's Standing group and the member's private line, a swipe of that reply takes it back (a code-only boundary: the only change at the swiped boundary is the move), and a reopen equals the replayed state. Never a number on the player surface. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v28-53-factions.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; return true;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error('the sandbox chat still holds ' + ctx.chat.length + ' message(s)'); return { cleared: true };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0 }); const pause = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)); const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error('timed out after ' + ms + ' ms: ' + what); await pause(200); } }; const standing = () => rt.getSnapshot().game?.standing ?? []; const values = () => rt.getEngineState().blackboard.values; const sheet = () => { const body = rt.getSnapshot().game?.statSheet?.body; return body && body.kind === 'meters' ? body.groups.find((group) => group.label === 'Standing') ?? null : null; }; const line = () => { const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const chid = ctx.characters.findIndex((character) => character.name === 'Arin'); rt.onMemberDrafted(chid); return String(rt.getAppliedEpistemicBlock() ?? ''); }; const clean = () => { const game = JSON.stringify({ standing: standing(), sheet: sheet() }); if (/\d/.test(game)) throw new Error('a number reached the Standing surface: ' + game); if (JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().game ?? {}).includes('rep_')) throw new Error('a standing key reached the player view'); }; const saved = async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 100 && rt.getSnapshot().saveHealth?.pendingBoundary != null; i += 1) await pause(100); if (rt.getSnapshot().saveHealth?.pendingBoundary != null) throw new Error('the last boundary is not saved'); }; const reopen = async () => { const chatId = SillyTavern.getContext().chatId; await SillyTavern.getContext().reloadCurrentChat(); await until(() => rt.getSnapshot().storyId === 'so-v28-53-factions', 10000, 'the story to hydrate after the reopen'); if (SillyTavern.getContext().chatId !== chatId) throw new Error('the reopen moved the page'); rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); await pause(1500); }; globalThis.__f53 = { pause, until, standing, values, sheet, line, clean, saved, reopen }; if (standing().length) throw new Error('a hidden faction reached the player before it was met: ' + JSON.stringify(standing())); if (values().rep_guild !== 0) throw new Error('standing is not seeded at start: ' + values().rep_guild); return { standing: standing(), rep: values().rep_guild };

steps.slash: /sendas name=Arin The Lantern Guild keeps its ledger behind the counter.

steps.eval: const f = globalThis.__f53; await f.until(() => f.standing().length === 1, 10000, 'the met faction to show'); const shown = f.standing(); if (shown[0].name !== 'The Lantern Guild' || shown[0].band !== 'Neutral') throw new Error('expected The Lantern Guild: Neutral, got ' + JSON.stringify(shown)); if (!f.sheet()) throw new Error('no Standing group on the Stat sheet'); f.clean(); await f.until(() => f.line().includes('regards the player as: Neutral'), 10000, 'the faction line of Arin'); const panel = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().factionsAuthor; if (!panel || panel.rows[0].value !== 0) throw new Error('Author view has no Factions row: ' + JSON.stringify(panel)); return { shown, panel: panel.rows[0].band };

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" Your hand closes on the ledger and you slip it under your coat.

steps.eval: const f = globalThis.__f53; await f.until(() => f.standing()[0]?.band === 'Hostile', 10000, 'the move to lower standing'); const values = f.values(); if (values.rep_guild !== -3 || typeof values.rep_guild_move_stole !== 'number') throw new Error('the move did not land once: ' + JSON.stringify({ rep: values.rep_guild, move: values.rep_guild_move_stole })); f.clean(); await f.until(() => f.line().includes('regards the player as: Hostile'), 10000, 'Arin to hear the faction-wide move'); globalThis.__f53.movedAt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getEngineState().lastMessageId; if (globalThis.__f53.movedAt !== SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length - 1) throw new Error('the move boundary is not on the last message'); await f.saved(); return { band: f.standing()[0].band, move: values.rep_guild_move_stole };
globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: false }); await globalThis.__f53.pause(800); return { authorView: false };
globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); await globalThis.__f53.pause(800); return { authorView: true };

const f = globalThis.__f53; await f.reopen(); if (f.standing()[0]?.band !== 'Hostile') throw new Error('the reopen changed the band: ' + JSON.stringify(f.standing())); return { band: f.standing()[0].band };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const last = ctx.chat.length - 1; if (last !== globalThis.__f53.movedAt) throw new Error('a message landed after the moving reply'); const reply = ctx.chat[last]; if (reply.is_user) throw new Error('the moving message is not a reply'); reply.swipes = [reply.mes, 'You look at the ledger and leave it where it lies.']; reply.swipe_id = 0; reply.swipe_info = [{}, {}]; await ctx.saveChat(); return { swipeable: last };

const f = globalThis.__f53; await f.until(() => f.standing()[0]?.band === 'Neutral', 15000, 'the swipe to take the move back'); const values = f.values(); if (values.rep_guild !== 0 || values.rep_guild_move_stole !== undefined || values.ledger_stolen === true) throw new Error('the swipe did not rewind the move: ' + JSON.stringify({ rep: values.rep_guild, move: values.rep_guild_move_stole, stolen: values.ledger_stolen })); await f.until(() => f.line().includes('regards the player as: Neutral'), 10000, 'the rollback to refresh the faction line of Arin'); f.clean(); await f.saved(); return { band: f.standing()[0].band };
const f = globalThis.__f53; await f.reopen(); if (f.standing()[0]?.band !== 'Neutral') throw new Error('the reopen re-applied the move'); return { band: f.standing()[0].band };
